title: Tech Note: Developer Hooks for 4D Ajax Framework
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Manager of Internal Systems, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the extensibility model (Developer Hooks) of the 4D Ajax Framework, a component-based AJAX/JavaScript web UI toolkit that was 4D's flagship approach to adding Web 2.0 interactivity to 4D databases in the late 2000s. The DAX_DevHook_* method architecture, DCS/DDW concepts, and the framework itself have been fully superseded by 4D's modern built-in Web Server, REST/ORDA-based APIs, and Qodly Studio, so none of this is directly applicable to current 4D development. It remains useful only as a historical illustration of how pre-ORDA, pre-Project-Mode 4D handled dynamic web data binding and custom UI extension points.
related_updates: The 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF/A4D) has been discontinued and is no longer bundled with or supported by current 4D releases
4D's web development approach has since moved to a built-in Web Server plus REST/ORDA APIs and, more recently, Qodly Studio for modern web UI building
